records.treatyStatusNote: The UAE is not a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention. Indian documents require full bilateral consular attestation.
records.authenticationRouteTitle: Bilateral Embassy Legalization Route (MEA + UAE Embassy + UAE MOFAIC)

stepByStepSequence.authority: Notary Public (India)
stepByStepSequence.description: Primary verification of original degree certificate and endorsement on reverse side.

stepByStepSequence.authority: State HRD Department or SDM (Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Delhi)
stepByStepSequence.description: State-level education department authentication (HRD) of the issuing state, or SDM New Delhi authentication where accepted.
stepByStepSequence.conditionNote: Certain UAE government ministries, ICP/GDRFA golden visa categories, or regulated professions (healthcare/teaching) may specifically require State HRD.

stepByStepSequence.authority: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), Government of India
stepByStepSequence.description: MEA CPV Division normal attestation ink stamp and officer signature (not an Apostille sticker).

stepByStepSequence.authority: UAE Embassy / Consulate in India (New Delhi / Mumbai)
stepByStepSequence.description: Consular attestation seal and digital sticker applied by the Embassy of the United Arab Emirates.

stepByStepSequence.authority: UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFAIC) — Post-Arrival
stepByStepSequence.description: Final counter-attestation inside the UAE before submission to MOHRE/GDRFA/ICP.

verifiedStatutoryRules: UAE is not a member of the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; MEA Normal Attestation + UAE Embassy Legalization is mandatory.
The UAE Embassy in India will only attest educational certificates that already bear valid State HRD/SDM and MEA India attestation stamps.
Original degree certificate (without lamination on the back) is required for physical ink stamping.
itemsRequiringConfirmation: Confirm with your UAE employer or licensing authority (e.g., DHA, DOH, MOE, MOHRE) whether SDM authentication is accepted or if State HRD + Equational Equivalency (MOE) is strictly mandated.
Check whether consolidated marksheets must be attested alongside the degree certificate.

translationRequirement.details: English degrees issued by recognized Indian universities are generally accepted in the UAE; legal Arabic translation is only required if requested by specific local courts or ministries.

specialCountryRequirements: UAE MOFAIC digital/counter-attestation is required inside the UAE after New Delhi UAE Embassy attestation.
UAE Ministry of Education (MOE) Equivalency Certificate is required for specific regulated roles and Golden Visa categories.

officialSources.title: MEA India — CPV Division Attestation & Apostille Guidelines
UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) — Document Attestation Service

researchMetadata.notes: Core high-volume route verified against MEA CPV and UAE MOFA guidelines.

records.treatyStatusNote: The UAE is not a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention. Bilateral embassy legalization is mandatory.

stepByStepSequence.authority: Notary Public (India)
stepByStepSequence.description: Initial notary verification on the original municipal/registrar birth certificate.

stepByStepSequence.authority: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM, Delhi) or State Home Department
stepByStepSequence.description: Administrative authentication prior to central ministry submission.

stepByStepSequence.authority: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), India
stepByStepSequence.description: MEA Normal Attestation stamp applied on the reverse of the original certificate.

stepByStepSequence.authority: UAE Embassy in New Delhi / Consulate in Mumbai
stepByStepSequence.description: UAE diplomatic mission legalization seal.

stepByStepSequence.authority: UAE MOFAIC (Inside UAE)
stepByStepSequence.description: Final attestation in the UAE for dependent/family residence visa processing.

verifiedStatutoryRules: For UAE family/dependent visa sponsorship (child residence permit), the Indian Birth Certificate must bear MEA Normal Attestation and UAE Embassy attestation followed by UAE MOFA.
Certificates issued in regional Indian languages without English text must be accompanied by an official English translation or bilingual municipal certificate.
itemsRequiringConfirmation: Verify that parents' names on the Birth Certificate exactly match the spellings in the parents' and child's Indian passports.

translationRequirement.details: English or bilingual (Regional + English) municipal certificates are accepted for MEA and UAE Embassy in India; Arabic translation may be required locally in the UAE depending on the emirate's GDRFA/ICP office.

specialCountryRequirements: Passport copies of both parents and the child are required as supporting documents for UAE Embassy submission.

itemsRequiringConfirmation: Check spouse name consistency across Marriage Certificate and both spouses' passports.

specialCountryRequirements: Clear passport copies of both husband and wife are required during UAE Embassy submission.

records.treatyStatusNote: Non-Hague destination. Commercial documents require Chamber + MEA + UAE Embassy attestation.
records.authenticationRouteTitle: Commercial Embassy Legalization Route (Chamber of Commerce → MEA → UAE Embassy → UAE MOFA)

stepByStepSequence.authority: Recognized Chamber of Commerce (India)

UAE Embassy commercial legalization fees vary by document type (COI, MOA, POA, Board Resolution, Commercial Invoice).
itemsRequiringConfirmation: Confirm with the UAE Free Zone or Department of Economic Development (DED) whether MOA, AOA, and Board Resolution must be attested as a combined set.

translationRequirement.details: Legal Arabic translation is frequently required inside the UAE prior to Notary/DED submission.

specialCountryRequirements: Company covering letter on official letterhead and signatory passport/PAN copy are required for Chamber and Embassy submission.

records.treatyStatusNote: Saudi Arabia acceded to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention (effective December 7, 2022). Most documents now follow the MEA Hague Apostille route, alongside Saudi QVP (Qiwa) / Culture requirements where applicable.
records.authenticationRouteTitle: Hague Apostille Route + Saudi QVP / Cultural Verification Check

stepByStepSequence.authority: Notary Public (India)
stepByStepSequence.description: Initial verification of the original degree certificate.

stepByStepSequence.authority: State HRD Department or SDM (Sub-Divisional Magistrate)
stepByStepSequence.description: State HRD authentication (strongly recommended for Saudi work visas) or SDM authentication.
stepByStepSequence.conditionNote: Saudi authorities and Saudi Cultural Mission / QVP frequently require State HRD authentication on educational degrees.

stepByStepSequence.authority: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), India — Hague Apostille
stepByStepSequence.description: Computer-generated MEA Hague Apostille sticker with unique serial and QR verification.

verifiedStatutoryRules: Saudi Arabia is a contracting state to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention since 7 December 2022.
Under the Hague Convention, an MEA Apostille sticker replaces routine Saudi Embassy consular legalization for standard public documents.
itemsRequiringConfirmation: Verify whether your profession requires Saudi Qualification Verification Program (QVP / Mosadaqa), Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE), or SCFHS (DataFlow) verification in addition to MEA Apostille.
Confirm with your Saudi sponsor/visa agency whether State HRD is mandatory prior to MEA Apostille.

translationRequirement.details: Certified Arabic translation may be required if requested by the Saudi employer or ministry.

specialCountryRequirements: Professional work visas for Saudi Arabia often require online Qualification Verification Program (QVP) registration in addition to physical document authentication.

records.treatyStatusNote: CRITICAL TREATY EXCEPTION: Although China acceded to the Hague Apostille Convention in November 2023, the Republic of India lodged a formal objection under Article 12. Therefore, the Apostille Convention IS NOT IN FORCE between India and Mainland China.
records.authenticationRouteTitle: Mandatory Bilateral Embassy Legalization Route (MEA Normal Attestation + Chinese Embassy New Delhi)

stepByStepSequence.authority: Notary Public (India)
stepByStepSequence.description: Notarial attestation of original degree certificate.

stepByStepSequence.authority: State HRD Department or SDM (New Delhi)
stepByStepSequence.description: State HRD or Sub-Divisional Magistrate authentication.

stepByStepSequence.authority: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), India — Normal Attestation
stepByStepSequence.description: MEA Normal Attestation ink stamp (DO NOT apply an Apostille sticker, as Chinese Embassy rejects Indian Apostilles).

stepByStepSequence.authority: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in India (New Delhi)
stepByStepSequence.description: Consular legalization via the Chinese Visa Application Service Center / Chinese Embassy in New Delhi.

verifiedStatutoryRules: Under Article 12 of the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention, the treaty does not apply between India and Mainland China due to India's formal objection to China's accession.
Documents issued in India for use in Mainland China MUST undergo MEA Normal Attestation followed by Consular Legalization by the Chinese Embassy/Consulate in India.
itemsRequiringConfirmation: Confirm whether Chinese translation is required before or after Chinese Embassy legalization for your work permit (Z-Visa) or university admission.
Note: Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR have separate treaty arrangements where Apostille applies, unlike Mainland China.

translationRequirement.details: Certified Chinese (Mandarin) translation is typically required by Chinese work permit and university authorities.

specialCountryRequirements: Never obtain an MEA Apostille sticker for Mainland China; request MEA Normal Attestation stamp + Chinese Embassy Legalization.
Original passport copy and application form for Consular Legalization are mandatory for Chinese Embassy submission.

officialSources.title: HCCH — 1961 Apostille Convention Status Table & Declarations (China / India Article 12 Objection)
Embassy of the People's Republic of China in India — Notice on Consular Legalization

records.treatyStatusNote: Qatar is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention. Bilateral MEA + Qatar Embassy legalization in New Delhi is mandatory.
records.authenticationRouteTitle: Bilateral Qatar Embassy Legalization Route (Complete 3-Document Educational Set)

stepByStepSequence.authority: Notary Public & State HRD / SDM (India)
stepByStepSequence.description: Authentication of Degree Certificate, Final/Consolidated Marksheets, and University Bonafide Letter.

stepByStepSequence.authority: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), India
stepByStepSequence.description: MEA Normal Attestation stamp on the educational documents.

stepByStepSequence.authority: Embassy of the State of Qatar (New Delhi)
stepByStepSequence.description: Qatar Embassy consular legalization (requires Degree + Transcript/Marksheets + Original University Verification/Bonafide Letter).

stepByStepSequence.authority: Qatar MOFA (Doha)
stepByStepSequence.description: Final counter-attestation at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Qatar.

verifiedStatutoryRules: Qatar is a non-Hague country; MEA Apostille is not valid for Qatar.

The Embassy of Qatar in India requires a complete educational set: (1) Original Degree Certificate, (2) Final/Consolidated Marksheet, and (3) a Bonafide / Mode of Study Certificate from the issuing university confirming regular (non-distance) study.
itemsRequiringConfirmation: Verify that your Bonafide Certificate explicitly states the course duration and that the mode of study was 'Regular / Full-Time' (distance/online degrees are generally not attested by Qatar Embassy).

translationRequirement.details: English documents are accepted by the Qatar Embassy in New Delhi; Arabic translation may be required in Doha.

specialCountryRequirements: Mandatory 3-document rule for Qatar educational attestation: Degree + Marksheets + Original Bonafide Certificate.

officialSources.title: MEA India — CPV Division Attestation Guidelines

records.treatyStatusNote: Germany and India are both contracting states to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention. MEA Apostille sticker is accepted for public documents.

stepByStepSequence.authority: Notary Public (India)
stepByStepSequence.description: Primary verification of the original degree certificate.

stepByStepSequence.authority: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) or State HRD Department
stepByStepSequence.description: State HRD or SDM authentication prior to MEA Apostille.

stepByStepSequence.authority: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), India — Hague Apostille
stepByStepSequence.description: Computerized MEA Hague Apostille sticker with QR verification applied on the reverse.

verifiedStatutoryRules: Germany is a member of the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; routine German Embassy legalization of Indian documents is replaced by the MEA Apostille.
For Indian students applying for German university admission and student visas, Academic Evaluation Centre (APS India) certification is mandatory.
itemsRequiringConfirmation: If applying for a German Student Visa, confirm your APS India verification requirements.
If applying for an EU Blue Card or Employment Visa, check ANABIN database recognition of your Indian university and whether certified German translation is needed.

translationRequirement.details: English degrees are often accepted for initial visa/university processing, while local German authorities (Standesamt/recognition bodies) may require sworn German translation.

specialCountryRequirements: APS India (Academic Evaluation Centre, New Delhi) certificate is mandatory for Indian applicants seeking a German student visa.

records.treatyStatusNote: Italy is a contracting state to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention. Requires MEA Apostille plus Italian translation/DOV for academic recognition.

stepByStepSequence.authority: State HRD Department or SDM (India)
stepByStepSequence.description: State HRD or SDM authentication (note: Italian Consulates for DOV often specify State HRD or Apostille rules by jurisdiction).

stepByStepSequence.authority: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), India — Hague Apostille
stepByStepSequence.description: MEA Hague Apostille sticker affixed to the original degree and transcripts.

stepByStepSequence.conditionNote: Required for higher education enrollment and academic recognition in Italy.

verifiedStatutoryRules: Italy is a 1961 Hague Apostille Convention member; all original Indian educational and personal documents must carry the MEA Apostille sticker before submission to Italian authorities.
For Italian study visas and university enrollment, Italian universities require either a Consular Declaration of Value (DOV) or a CIMEA Statement of Comparability.
itemsRequiringConfirmation: Check your Italian university's call for applications (Universitaly summary) to confirm whether they accept CIMEA or require a physical DOV from the Italian Embassy/Consulate in New Delhi/Mumbai/Kolkata/Bengaluru.

translationRequirement.details: Official Italian translation (legalized or with translator apostille/consular stamp) is required for DOV and municipal submissions in Italy.

specialCountryRequirements: Declaration of Value (DOV) applications require the original Apostilled degree, Apostilled transcripts, and certified Italian translations.
